acquisition_method: Data-dependent acquisition (DDA) was performed with the resolution of the Orbitrap set to 30,000
cleavage_agent: The following modifications were included into the search parameters: Carbamidomethyl (C) and TMT16 (K) as fixed modifications, Acetyl (Protein N-term), Oxidation (M) and TMT10 or TMT16 (N-term) as variable modifications. For the full scan (MS1) a mass error tolerance of 10 ppm and for MS/MS (MS2) spectra of 0.02 Da were used. Further parameters were trypsin as a protease with an allowance of a maximum of two missed cleavages
collision_energy: A normalized collision energy of 34 was applied.
fractionation_method: Off-line high pH reverse phase fractionation was carried out on an Agilent 1200 Infinity high-performance liquid chromatography system
fragmentation_method: A normalized collision energy of 34 was applied.
instrument: an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) was coupled directly to
ionization_type: using the Nanospray Flex ion source in positive ion mode.
labeling: For each sample, 20 μg of peptides were labeled with TMT Isobaric Label Reagent (Thermo Fisher Scientific) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
mass_analyzer: Full mass scan was acquired with mass range 375–1500 m/z in profile mode in the Orbitrap with resolution of 120,000.
ptm: Carbamidomethyl (C), TMT16 (K), Acetyl (Protein N-term), Oxidation (M), TMT10 or TMT16 (N-term)
